item_summary: $30-50 vertically oriented ergonomic wireless mouse with adjustable DPI and programmable side buttons to reduce wrist strain
detailed_item_draft: Seeking a vertically oriented wireless ergonomic mouse priced between 30 and 50 USD. The device must feature a distinct vertical handshake design with an approximate 57-degree angle to reduce wrist pronation and strain. Technical specifications must include an optical sensor with adjustable DPI settings ranging from 800 to 4000 or higher. The device requires a minimum of two programmable side buttons accessible via the thumb rest, with driver support for macro customization. Connectivity must be wireless via 2.4GHz USB receiver or Bluetooth 5.0, ensuring minimal input lag. Build quality should include a contoured palm rest, textured rubber side grips, and compatibility with Windows 10/11 and macOS. Battery performance should support at least 30 days of typical use per charge or battery set. The product must be new, from a recognized brand, and include a minimum 12-month manufacturer warranty.
